title: Data Handling Notice
description: Displays the data-handling notice: a title and three statements about confidentiality, checking before sharing, and the user's responsibility.

noticeTitle.title: Notice Title
noticeTitle.description: Title of the notice, shown next to the warning icon.

noticeConfidential.title: Notice: Confidential
noticeConfidential.description: Statement that the data may contain confidential information.

noticeShareCheck.title: Notice: Share Check
noticeShareCheck.description: Statement asking the user to check the recipients and the content before sharing.

noticeResponsibility.title: Notice: Responsibility
noticeResponsibility.description: Statement that the user is responsible for handling the data.
